gRPC HTTP/2 header encoding and response parsing helpers, plus gRPC status strings.

# Purpose
This file implements gRPC support on top of HTTP/2 and HPACK. The [`fd_grpc_h2_gen_request_hdrs`](<#fd_grpc_h2_gen_request_hdrs>) function builds the request header block for a gRPC call by writing the required HTTP/2 pseudo headers and gRPC headers, including `:method`, `:scheme`, `:path`, `:authority`, `te: trailers`, `content-type`, `user-agent`, and optional bearer authorization. The helper [`fd_hpack_wr_content_type_grpc`](<#fd_hpack_wr_content_type_grpc>) writes the fixed `content-type` value for gRPC, and the code uses HPACK writer functions to encode each header into the transmit buffer.

The file also parses HTTP/2 response headers for gRPC replies. The [`fd_grpc_h2_read_response_hdrs`](<#fd_grpc_h2_read_response_hdrs>) function decodes HPACK header blocks, matches header names, and stores the HTTP status, gRPC content type flag, gRPC status code, and gRPC error message in the response structure. The helper [`fd_grpc_h2_parse_num`](<#fd_grpc_h2_parse_num>) converts decimal header values into integers, and [`fd_grpc_status_cstr`](<#fd_grpc_status_cstr>) maps gRPC status codes to text strings for logging or error reporting.
